## Problem and symptoms

- Low-cost humanoid projects often only open-source one layer, making it difficult to form a reproducible closed loop.
- The post did not report specific faults.

## Environment

- Approximately $2,500 3D-printed humanoid; open-source soft hardware stack.

## Priority diagnostics

- Checked CAD, runtime, calibration, simulation, identification, and training for version binding.

## Possible causes

- Missing any layer would transfer system integration cost to the reproducer.

## Attempts

- Released full stack and provided blog/code.

## Effective fixes

- Candidate mechanism is closed-loop versioned full stack, not isolated models.
